saving.sentenceEn: Savings rates in America have dropped in recent decades even though people's life expectancy has increased.

saving.sentenceEn: It can help companies increase their savings significantly.

series.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

series.sentenceEn: And then, maybe we can watch the series together.

series.sentenceEn: I can't remember his name, but he's written three books in all, and The Three Body Problem is the first in the series .

style.sentenceEn: While analytical decision-makers benefit from a deliberate, thoughtful approach, this style also has some shortcomings.

style.sentenceEn: Leaders who use this style don't want to make mistakes.
style.translationZh: 采用这种风格的领导者不希望出错。
style.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

style.sentenceEn: This style contrasts with more instinctive leadership styles where managers make many decisions using instinct or opinion.
style.translationZh: 这种风格与更具直觉性的领导风格形成鲜明对比，在后者中，管理者往往凭直觉或主观看法做出许多决策。
style.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

style.sentenceEn: And these attachment styles carry on into adulthood.
style.translationZh: 而这些依恋类型会延续到成年时期。

style.sentenceEn: They have a distinctive style of handwriting.
style.translationZh: 他们的书写风格与众不同。

stage.sentenceEn: Since your baby doesn't dream at this stage of brain development, it's safe to assume babies do not have nightmares, either.

stage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

stage.sentenceEn: Saying "no" is an important skill to develop at any stage of your career because it retains the most important asset in life: your time.

stage.sentenceEn: He walked across the stage as the audience cheered.
stage.translationZh: 在观众的欢呼声中，他走上了舞台。
stage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第12句

stage.sentenceEn: The close link between age and stage may cease to exist in a multi-stage life.

stage.sentenceEn: They vary in different stages of brain development.

self.sentenceEn: We get to enjoy the very concrete, immediate benefits of our actions while someone else (namely, our future selves ) suffers the hypothetical(假设的), far-off consequences.
self.translationZh: 我们得以享受自己行为带来的非常具体、立竿见影的好处，而让别人（即未来的自己）承受那些假设性的、遥远的后果。

self.sentenceEn: While those visions of our future selves can be inspiring, when it comes to actually doing the day-to-day work, it may be more effective to reframe activities in terms of their immediate, or at least very near-term, rewards.
self.translationZh: 虽然对未来自我的憧憬能给人启发，但在实际进行日常工作时，将活动重新定义为能带来即时或至少近期回报的事情，可能会更有效。

self.sentenceEn: In other words, present self trumps(战胜) future self .
self.translationZh: 换句话说，当下的自我战胜了未来的自我。

self.sentenceEn: To help explain this seemingly irrational behavior, Hershfield and his team scanned the brains of study participants while asking them to what degree various traits(特征)—like "honorable" or "funny"—applied to their current self , their future self , a current other, or a future other.
self.translationZh: 为了解释这种看似非理性的行为，赫什菲尔德及其团队扫描了研究参与者的大脑，同时询问他们各种特征（如“正直”或“风趣”）在多大程度上适用于当前的自己、未来的自己、当前的他人或未来的他人。

self.sentenceEn: Instead of fighting your present self's need for immediate rewards, why not use it to your advantage?
self.translationZh: 与其抗拒当下的自己对即时回报的需求，何不将其为你所用呢？

self.sentenceEn: We will be discouraged from revealing our true selves .
self.translationZh: 我们会不敢展现真实的自我。

satisfaction.sentenceEn: Customer satisfaction takes a hit as well.

satisfaction.sentenceEn: Because there is a delayed satisfaction associated with self-control, it can be easy to get off track.

satisfaction.sentenceEn: All of this was done in the name of increasing job satisfaction and giving workers greater flexibility, and to assure workers that it was something management was committed to.
satisfaction.translationZh: 所有这一切都是以提高工作满意度、给予员工更大灵活性为名义进行的，同时也是为了向员工保证这是管理层所承诺的事情。

satisfaction.sentenceEn: People over 45 stimulated by training suffer shorter periods of unemployment, get more job offers and have greater satisfaction in them.
satisfaction.translationZh: 45岁以上的人群在接受培训激励后，失业时间更短，获得的就业机会更多，且职业满意度也更高。

satisfaction.translationZh: 选择越少，客户满意度就越低。

senior.sentenceEn: In their 2020 study, the researchers interviewed nearly 80 employees at two London-based firms—an equal number of men and women between the ages of 30 and 50, all with at least one dependent child—who worked in middle or senior management roles.

survive.sentenceEn: Remember, failure is inevitable, and every failure you survive is a learning experience.

session.sentenceEn: Offering online classes certainly helps students who would otherwise not be able to attend classroom sessions .

session.sentenceEn: You probably have to help younger children plan their session , but it's important that by the end of primary school it's second nature.

suddenly.sentenceEn: Seen through the lens of the present self versus the future self, our self-defeating actions—like choosing to watch television rather than go to the gym— suddenly make perfect sense.

safely.sentenceEn: During Covid, restaurants and cafés lost so much business that cities nationwide began allowing them to build curbside seating areas where people could sit, safely , in the open air.

safely.sentenceEn: The criterion for a snow day is primarily the inability of school buses to operate safely on their routes and danger to children who walk to school.
safely.translationZh: 决定是否因雪停课的主要标准是校车能否在路线上安全行驶，以及步行上学的儿童是否面临危险。

safely.sentenceEn: "And an error occurred during the connections in Denver. We have notified our customers that their pets arrived safely . We will arrange to return the pets to them as soon as possible," a spokesperson of United Airlines said.
safely.translationZh: 美国联合航空公司的一位发言人表示：“在丹佛转机过程中出现了失误。我们已通知客户他们的宠物已安全抵达。我们将尽快安排将宠物送还给他们。”
safely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

safely.sentenceEn: A small plane with two sick US workers arrived safely in Chile late Wednesday after leaving Antarctica in a daring rescue mission from a remote South Pole research station.
safely.translationZh: 一架载有两名患病美国工作人员的小型飞机完成了从偏远南极科考站大胆的救援任务，离开南极洲后，于周三晚间安全抵达智利。
safely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

safely.sentenceEn: Kelly Swisher, an Arkansas woman, escaped injury and managed to safely stop her car after a 4-foot-long rat snake came out from under her car seat and slid across her feet as she was driving down the highway.
safely.translationZh: 阿肯色州妇女凯利·斯威舍在高速公路上驾车时，一条4英尺长的锦蛇从她的汽车座椅下钻出来，滑过她的脚面，她成功避开了伤害并安全地停下了车。
safely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

safely.sentenceEn: The New York dance club also serves as a place for entertainment where youngsters can enjoy themselves safely .
safely.translationZh: 这家纽约舞蹈俱乐部同时也是娱乐场所，年轻人可以在这里安全地尽情玩乐。

seeker.sentenceEn: They rate the post-45 job seekers lower on average on all three measures — even experience — than those ages 18 to 34.
seeker.translationZh: 对于 45 岁以上的求职者，他们在所有三项衡量标准（甚至包括经验）上的平均评分都低于 18 至 34 岁的求职者。

seeker.sentenceEn: It finds that sharing information about diversity makes job postings more attractive to job seekers , even when pay is lower.
seeker.translationZh: 研究发现，分享有关多元化的信息会使招聘信息对求职者更具吸引力，即使薪资较低也是如此。
seeker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

seeker.sentenceEn: A new study finds that job seekers are even willing to explore jobs with lower salaries when companies are more diverse.
seeker.translationZh: 一项新研究发现，当公司更加多元化时，求职者甚至愿意考虑薪资更低的工作。
seeker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

seeker.sentenceEn: Having a growth mindset of interest can help job seekers expand their interests and become more adaptable to different fields, and take the initiative to learn new skills.
seeker.translationZh: 拥有成长型兴趣思维倾向可以帮助求职者拓展兴趣范围，提高对不同领域的适应能力，并主动学习新技能。
seeker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

seeker.sentenceEn: Drawing in adventure seekers and experienced divers, this new artificial Airbus reef will be a scuba diver's paradise(天堂).
seeker.translationZh: 这处全新的空客人工鱼礁将吸引众多探险爱好者和经验丰富的潜水员，成为水肺潜水者的天堂。
seeker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

seeker.sentenceEn: When are job seekers willing to explore jobs with lower salaries, according to a new study?
seeker.translationZh: 根据一项新研究，求职者在什么情况下愿意考虑薪资较低的工作？

sex.sentenceEn: Ford takes the reader through the evolution of fashion while examining the underlying motivations of status, sex , power, and personality, which, he assumes, influenced all innovations in fashion in the past and which continue to influence us today.
sex.translationZh: 福特带领读者回顾了时尚的演变历程，同时探讨了地位、性别、权力和个性这些深层动机——他认为这些因素不仅影响了过去所有的时尚创新，至今仍在影响着我们。
sex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

sex.sentenceEn: Although men's touching is more normal in these cultures, physical contact between persons of opposite sexes who are not family members is negatively perceived in Arabian countries.
sex.translationZh: 尽管在这些文化中男性间的身体接触更为正常，但在阿拉伯国家，非家庭成员的异性之间的身体接触却会受到负面看待。
sex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

sex.sentenceEn: Participants were balanced across the three groups for age, sex , educational background, severity and duration of depression, and use of antidepressants(抗抑郁药).
sex.translationZh: 这三组参与者在年龄、性别、教育背景、抑郁症的严重程度和持续时间以及抗抑郁药使用情况方面保持了平衡。
sex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

sex.sentenceEn: Many men and women have long bought into the idea that there are "male" and "female" brains, believing that explains just about every difference between the sexes .
sex.translationZh: 长期以来，许多男性和女性都认同存在“男性大脑”和“女性大脑”这一观点，并认为这几乎可以解释两性之间的所有差异。
sex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

sex.sentenceEn: In the study, Tel Aviv University researchers searched for sex differences throughout the entire human brain.
sex.translationZh: 在这项研究中，特拉维夫大学的研究人员在整个人脑中寻找性别差异。
sex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

sex.sentenceEn: "There's a mountain of evidence proving the importance of sex influences at all levels of brain function," he told The Seattle Times.
sex.translationZh: 他在接受《西雅图时报》采访时表示：“有大量证据表明，性别对大脑各个层面的功能都有重要影响。”
sex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

similarly.sentenceEn: Similarly , nutrition research sponsored by the food industry is more likely to end up favoring the food under consideration than independently funded research.
similarly.translationZh: 同样，由食品行业资助的营养研究比独立资助的研究更有可能得出有利于所研究食品的结论。
similarly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

similarly.sentenceEn: Results showed both groups of children were rated similarly on important social skills.
similarly.translationZh: 结果显示，两组儿童在重要社交技能方面的评分相似。
similarly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

similarly.sentenceEn: They were also rated similarly on self-control, such as the ability to regulate their temper.
similarly.translationZh: 两组儿童在自控能力方面的评分也相近，例如调节情绪的能力。
similarly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

similarly.sentenceEn: Similarly , being creative involves "thinking outside the box", deviating from expectations.
similarly.translationZh: 同样地，创造力需要“跳出思维定势”，打破常规预期。

similarly.sentenceEn: Similarly , I personally believe that you must be comfortable and happy in your own company before you can truly be yourself in the company of others.
similarly.translationZh: 同样地，我个人认为，一个人只有先学会与自己舒适快乐地相处，才能在他人面前真正做自己。
similarly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

similarly.sentenceEn: Similarly with earnings, young men's wages (after adjusting for inflation) have been on a downward trajectory(轨迹) since 1970 and fell significantly from 2000 to 2010.
similarly.translationZh: 收入方面同样如此，自1970年以来，年轻男性的工资（经通胀调整后）一直呈下降趋势，且在2000年至2010年间显著下降。

smoker.sentenceEn: "One of the reasons I find this topic very interesting is because my mom was a smoker when I was younger," says Lindson-Hawley, who studies tobacco and health at the University of Oxford.
smoker.translationZh: 牛津大学烟草与健康研究员林德森-霍利表示：“我对这个话题特别感兴趣的原因之一是，我小时候母亲是个吸烟者。”
smoker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

smoker.sentenceEn: By studying about 700 adult smokers , she found out that her mom quit the right way—by stopping abruptly and completely.
smoker.translationZh: 通过研究约700名成年吸烟者，她发现她母亲的戒烟方法是正确的——突然且彻底地停止吸烟。
smoker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

smoker.sentenceEn: For example, Karen Hayes, a life coach in Toronto, conducts knitting therapy programs, including Knit to Quit to help smokers give up the habit, and Knit to Heal for people coping with health crises, like a cancer diagnosis or serious illness of a family member.
smoker.translationZh: 例如，多伦多的生活教练凯伦·海耶斯开展了编织疗法项目，其中包括“编织戒烟”项目以帮助吸烟者戒除烟瘾，以及“编织疗愈”项目，面向那些正应对健康危机的人群，如被诊断患有癌症或家人患重病的人。

smoker.sentenceEn: The biggest increases tended to be in brands that were popular with young smokers .
smoker.translationZh: 尼古丁含量增幅最大的往往是那些受年轻吸烟者欢迎的品牌。
smoker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

smoker.sentenceEn: What kind of support did smokers receive to quit smoking in Lindson-Hawley's study?
smoker.translationZh: 在林德森-霍利的研究中，吸烟者获得了哪些戒烟支持？

smoker.sentenceEn: She studied the smoking patterns of adult smokers .
smoker.translationZh: 她研究了成年吸烟者的吸烟模式。

soreness.sentenceEn: That's why there is most often a delay associated with muscle soreness .
soreness.translationZh: 这就是为什么肌肉酸痛往往会有延迟性。
soreness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第13句

soreness.sentenceEn: According to a German professor, the soreness comes from straining your muscles in an uncommon way, for example, jumping on a bicycle for a ride, because you haven't ridden in a long time.
soreness.translationZh: 一位德国教授指出，这种酸痛源于肌肉受到不寻常方式的拉伸，例如，久未骑行后突然骑自行车。
soreness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

soreness.sentenceEn: As muscle soreness develops, the body has to work to repair the muscle tears.
soreness.translationZh: 当肌肉酸痛出现时，身体就必须开始修复肌肉的撕裂。
soreness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

soreness.sentenceEn: Unfortunately, there is little that can be done to relieve muscle soreness .
soreness.translationZh: 遗憾的是，几乎没有什么方法可以缓解肌肉酸痛。
soreness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第15句

soreness.sentenceEn: Soreness occurs since your leg muscles aren't used to that movement.
soreness.translationZh: 之所以会出现酸痛感，是因为你的腿部肌肉不习惯那种运动方式。
soreness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

soreness.sentenceEn: What does the German professor say about muscle soreness ?
soreness.translationZh: 这位德国教授对肌肉酸痛有何看法？

spacecraft.sentenceEn: He also helped dock two spacecraft .
spacecraft.translationZh: 他还协助对接了两艘航天器。
spacecraft.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

spacecraft.sentenceEn: Current spacecraft use a variety of fuels, but most are based on fossil fuels.
spacecraft.translationZh: 目前的航天器使用多种燃料，但大多数以化石燃料为基础。
spacecraft.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

spacecraft.sentenceEn: The spacecraft will reach a height of around 200 km.
spacecraft.translationZh: 该航天器将升至约200公里的高度。

spacecraft.sentenceEn: In 2015, two Italian companies collaborated on the construction of a similar type of spacecraft , which was the first coffee machine designed for use in space.
spacecraft.translationZh: 2015年，两家意大利公司合作建造了一种类似的航天器，这是第一台专为太空使用设计的咖啡机。
spacecraft.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

spacecraft.sentenceEn: What do we learn from the passage about the lift-off of spacecraft ?

stressful.sentenceEn: So, if your baby seems to be in a stressful state while sleeping or is upset upon waking, there may be other factors at play.
stressful.translationZh: 因此，如果你的宝宝在睡觉时表现出压力感，或者在醒来时情绪不安，可能还有其他因素在起作用。
stressful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

stressful.sentenceEn: While being married is great and wonderful, the act of getting married can be quite stressful .
stressful.translationZh: 虽然婚姻生活美好而奇妙，但筹备婚礼的过程却可能充满压力。

stressful.sentenceEn: It all started in 1991 when the Harvard-educated physician was transferred from working in a stressful emergency room to being the medical director of a nursing home in upstate New York.
stressful.translationZh: 这一切始于1991年，这位哈佛毕业的医生从压力重重的急诊室调任纽约州北部一家养老院的医疗主任。
stressful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

stressful.sentenceEn: A Japanese IT firm has officially introduced an "office cat" policy to combat the stressful environment of the workplace.
stressful.translationZh: 一家日本IT公司正式推出了一项“办公室猫咪”政策，以缓解工作场所的紧张环境。
stressful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

stressful.sentenceEn: Money therefore becomes a stressful topic, and so the thought of sitting down and planning is an unattractive proposition.
stressful.translationZh: 因此，金钱变成了一个令人紧张的话题，所以坐下来做财务规划的想法就变得毫无吸引力。
stressful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

stressful.sentenceEn: The start of high school doesn't have to be stressful
stressful.translationZh: 高中生活的开始并非一定要充满压力

stroke.sentenceEn: Diets high in fibre have been linked to a lower risk of developing heart disease, stroke , high blood pressure and diabetes, and it's recommended adults consume 30g per day.
stroke.translationZh: 高纤维饮食与降低患心脏病、中风、高血压和糖尿病的风险有关，建议成年人每天摄入30克纤维。

stroke.sentenceEn: Researchers, writing in the journal Heart, pooled data from 23 studies and found that social isolation or feelings of loneliness were tied to an increased risk of coronary heart disease(冠心病) and strokes .
stroke.translationZh: 研究人员在《心脏》期刊上发表文章称，他们汇总了23项研究的数据后发现，社交孤立或孤独感与冠心病和中风风险增加有关。
stroke.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

stroke.sentenceEn: Social isolation and loneliness were determined with questionnaires; the researchers depended on medical records and death certificates for determining coronary events and strokes .
stroke.translationZh: 研究人员通过问卷调查来确定社交孤立和孤独感；而冠心病事件和中风的诊断则依据医疗记录和死亡证明。
stroke.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

stroke.sentenceEn: There were 4,628 coronary events and 3,002 strokes in follow-up periods ranging from three to 21 years.
stroke.translationZh: 在3至21年的随访期内，共发生4628例冠心病事件和3002例中风。
stroke.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

stroke.sentenceEn: The scientists found that loneliness and social isolation increased the relative risk of having a heart attack or a death from heart disease by 29 percent, and the risk of stroke by 32 percent.
stroke.translationZh: 科学家们发现，孤独感和社会隔离使心脏病发作或心脏病死亡的相对风险增加29%，中风风险增加32%。
stroke.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

stroke.sentenceEn: According to the World Health Organization, 80 percent of deaths from heart disease and stroke are caused by high blood pressure, tobacco use, elevated cholesterol and low consumption of fruits and vegetables.
stroke.translationZh: 世界卫生组织的数据显示，80%的心脏病和中风死亡病例是由高血压、吸烟、高胆固醇以及水果和蔬菜摄入量不足引起的。

substance.sentenceEn: However, "the whole concept of a juice diet helping to remove poisonous or harmful substances from the body is completely false," says Clemens.
substance.translationZh: 然而，克莱门斯说：“果汁饮食有助于清除体内有毒或有害物质的整个概念是完全错误的。”

substance.sentenceEn: Another reason for fruit juice's recent popularity is the argument that it can help to remove poisonous or harmful substances from the body.
substance.translationZh: 果汁近来受欢迎的另一个原因是有人认为它有助于清除体内的有毒或有害物质。

substance.sentenceEn: After contacting the chocolate manufacturer, the firefighters resorted to spraying hot, pressurized water to get rid of the sticky substance .
substance.translationZh: 在联系巧克力生产商后，消防人员采取了喷洒高压热水的方法来清除这种粘稠物质。
substance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

substance.sentenceEn: These microplastics included a substance commonly known as PET and widely used in the manufacture of clothing and food and liquid containers.
substance.translationZh: 这些微塑料中含有一种通常被称为PET的物质，该物质广泛用于制造服装、食品及液体容器。
substance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

substance.sentenceEn: Some people believe a juice diet helps to rid our body of harmful or poisonous substances .

substance.sentenceEn: It was a hard task to remove the spilled substance .
substance.translationZh: 清除泄漏的物质是一项艰巨的任务。

substitute.sentenceEn: They're nutritious, inexpensive, and far more sustainable than any of the processed meatless substitutes on the market today.
substitute.translationZh: 它们营养丰富、价格实惠，而且比当今市场上任何加工肉类替代品都要可持续得多。
substitute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

substitute.sentenceEn: Beans are an especially excellent protein substitute .
substitute.translationZh: 豆类是一种特别优质的蛋白质替代品。
substitute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

substitute.sentenceEn: The most common question I'm asked always centers around how to get started in user experience design, to which my response is always that nothing can substitute real-world experience.
substitute.translationZh: 我最常被问到的问题总是围绕着如何入行用户体验设计，而我的回答也始终如一：没有什么能替代实战经验。
substitute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

substitute.sentenceEn: But once again, nothing can substitute real-world experience.
substitute.translationZh: 但话说回来，任何东西都无法取代实战经验。
substitute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

substitute.sentenceEn: What we call "work-life balance" is actually just a substitute to having a sense of fulfillment and contentment.
substitute.translationZh: 我们所谓的“工作生活平衡”，实际上只是拥有成就感和满足感的一种替代说法。

substitute.sentenceEn: It substitutes old information with new data.
substitute.translationZh: 它用新数据替代旧信息。

subway.sentenceEn: I know many cities in the world have air conditioning in their subway , so why can't we?
subway.translationZh: 我知道世界上很多城市的地铁都有空调，为什么我们这里就不能有呢？
